review_description: From quote to install was around a week, amazing customer service, very thorough and efficient, cannot recommend Tony highly enough.The installers were very professional,  cleaned and tidied afterwards, no fuss, just worked hard to get the job done.Very happy with the entire process, glad I chose this company, it could not have gone any better! A big thank you to Tony and his team!
This company had installed our neighbours solar only about 6 weeks before.   The salesperson is a close friend of our neighbour. We had 15 monocrystalline panels and a Sunnyboy inverter. $5000.00

Installed in Nov 2012. The installers were very rough (damaged the roof and guttering and left components behind), unreliable and the communication with Blu Sky and, ultimately, to me was appalling. As I write this (July 2014) the inverter is showing an error message and I may have to replace it for the fifth time.This would have to rate as the worst, most sustained, consumer experience I've had. I cannot explain why the company has such a good reputation here. I hope I can get warranty work through a different installer/supplier.

Nick was very helpful - explained everything thoroughly. Couldn't have asked for better service.We are very pleased to have the Solar Panels and Inverter installed and see it working - our electrical meter is now going backwards!! Now all we need is for ETSA to install the import/export meter and we are in business!We were very pleased with the efficient manner in which the two young men, Wayne & Dmitry, from RTC Electrical, carried out the installation.We are very happy so far - just waiting for ETSA.

It was "pain free" with all applications etc. handled for us. The process from acceptance of quote to change of meter by ETSA was very quick. The sales rep, installers etc. were very obliging and kept us informed in a most professional way. We are glad we used the Solar Quotes site.

I was very happy with their representative, answered all my questions and spent quiet a time doing so. He inspected the roof, took photos of the ETSA power meter. because my roof is not that big he suggested 250 watt monocrystalline panels (6) and I was able to change the inverter to a Sunny Boy.BLU SKY Make all the necessary arrangements, certificates change of ETSA meter etc. they also spent the most time making sure I was comfortable with the purchase.

Nick from BluskySolar was fantastic all the way through, no question and no system information change or configuration was too hard, and what impressed me the most was the fact I received a change confirmation and price adjustment in writing each time..And this was even before I made a commitment to purchase!!!With the decision made I contacted Nick and made a time to call and finalise the paperwork. At the time I was told that RTC electrical will contact me directly after they come back to work in the new year on or about Jan 9. I thought to myself sure !!!!  more like end Jan !!  Happy to say I was very wrong.On January 10th  I receive a call from RTC  stating they can come and  install the system on the 13th , after pressing a few panic buttons we agreed on the day and the install crew arrived early morning. They install crew were fantastic !!   Nothing was too hard !! They were quick, clean, and very efficient. I was given a full run down on the system and its operation before they left. As the inverter was going in the laundry next to my meter I was concerned about the looks etc, I had nothing to worry about !!! The install is a work of artÃ¢â‚¬Â¦The same afternoon I received an email from BluskySolar advising the approval numbers and meter change over booking date with ETSA, no more to do just sit wait for the day.A 3kw system mounted on a purpose built platform with 10 ET 300W panels a Samilpower 3480 inverter has so far been producing far in excess of its stated average.Thank you, Solar Quotes, BluskySolar and RTC Electrical for a hassle and pain free experience..I have no hesitation in recommending Bluskysolar to anyone who is considering a solar power system purchase.

We found Paul from Blu Sky Solar very genuine with his advice & follow up service.  He was a real gentleman & a man who stuck by his word.  We would highly recommend this solar company above all others because of their high standards not only in their installation but also their business ethics.
Great service!Easy to talk to!Gave you options and they didn't talk you in to anything!Did all the work for you!Very quick!Great work :) !!!!
Would highly recommend anyone to go through this company. Had no hassles from the word go, everything was organised and ran on time and fitted right into the budget. Excellent company.

Dear Nick and crew at Blu sky,Thank you for the receipt and our kindest regards for the brilliant, efficient service and installation of our solar system.  We are thrilled with the overall service and assistance we received from Nick selling us the unit to the installation by your friendly, prompt installers.  Our recommendation for your company would be gladly given to anyone looking for solar.RegardsSharon and Tony
Blu Sky Solar made it so easy for me to understand solar and were so friendly with no pressure, I will highly recommend them in the future!

We got faranda solar and electrical, and from the time i contacted him he came straight out,and discussed the deal with us ,and had the installation done within 2 weeks,we are very pleased with the service,and price,we would recommend them to others.

I found BluSky to be very solicitous, and they held my hand all the way through the process from initial consult to installation.  No heavy selling, and genuine discussion of the options.  Solar has been working for 3 days, and performing above spec in spite of shading issues that I need to deal with.  Very highly recommended.

The salesman from NOW  Energy recommended I install Micro inverters but the salesman from Blue Sky said they weren't very robust and that they had recently stopped using them because of replacements frequency. I had a Growatt inverter fitted because both agreed they were acceptable and " Did the Job". The Micro inverter system was around $9K and the one I ended up with was nearly half that amount. I still don't know if I have installed the right system but it certainly cost less than my mates' system that cost him approx $8K or so. Looking forward to my power bill and then I can say more.

After doing the research with soalr quotes and other sites and deciding to go with a micro ac system after almost a year since install there was an early failure of 1 micro unit in the 1st month (I had added that into to my original research of the possibility) but replacement was quick and easy. All the information supplied by Kyle and Blu Sky was correct and it has even been surpassed with a full 10 kw generated at stages from east west facing panels. I've had to pay no bills from time of install and no bills in winter (even with the electricity company putting their prices up again) summer is looking like a time for some nice records and no bill shock.

Was a little bit miffed when he said he would 'throw in the Bluetooth for me' then when I read up on the manufactures webpage and discovered that all there units came with Bluetooth standard.Installers did a fast tidy job.I had a huge headache with the GGG as they came out and quoted me first and put in for my solar credits, then I had to go to the GGG head office with a stat dec signed stating that I didn't want them to do my install!!!
Still waiting on install, hopefully in the near future.

The main reason I went with Blusky Solar was their promise to install the system within 1-2 weeks of signing the contract. I should have known this was too good to be true. The install instead took about 6 weeks.The installation contractors were a mess, they came 5 hours late on a Friday so some of the job had to be postponed to the Monday after. They never showed up on Monday and after many calls came to finish their job about 2 weeks later.Hopefully the system will perform better.

Blu Sky Solar are hands down excellent. Don't hesitate to inquire. Here's why....We purchased a 5KW APS Micro Inverter system from them a while ago at a truly great price. In an AC micro inverter system each panel is individually tracked, optimised and any problems are easily identified and isolated only to the panels involved, unlike in a DC system where it can affect the entire string. They work in very low light. Often referred to as an "AC system" they are consequently safer as well.It's great for our power bill. It produces decent power even when it's quite overcast. It even produces power when it's raining!APS Micro Inverters also have a 25 year warranty.No installation is required on the side of the house, just a small Energy Communications Unit (ECU) plugged into an existing wall socket inside. The ECU connects to our home wi-fi. We monitor our system directly with a PC or laptop, it's updated every 5 mins. The ECU also connects to the APS website where we have a personal account that gives us a plethora of info about our system. This includes detailed performance graphs, overall and/or each individual panels, daily and over it's lifetime... even an animation of the panels' energy production over any day selected! Quite incredible. Any issues can easily be identified... to the exact panel, day and time it occurred!Blu Sky's rep was friendly and not pushy. Blu Sky produced the best panel outlay design and not only were they were quite knowledgeable about microinverter systems when we inquired... they were positioned to supply the system with quality ET panels at an excellent price. All the warranties offered were as good as anybody else's, if not better.The installation crew were professional and efficient, the quality of the materials and workmanship was excellent. We would give them 5 out of 5 except they made a small change to the original design for convenience sake and we have had some minor qualms as to the impact of these changes. Whilst we are not sure as to the exact amount we are confident it is of little significance (if any) overall. And being a micro-inverter system it is confined to only a couple of panels and not the whole string. Just make sure you are fully informed as to the ramifications of any change to the original plan in regards to shading and power generation.After service has been great since the installation, which was about a fortnight after signing. Not long after, whilst monitoring the system online, we detected a panel failure and it was promptly and cheerfully addressed. A bit later the ECU failed and APS showed such concern they express freighted a new one and paid to have the old one freighted back.We were tardy with this review but it's given us a chance to say so far that we have nothing but praise for Blu Sky Solar; in both the sale and follow up service, and are very happy we went with them.

Very well informed, friendly and helpful from the first call to the commissioning of the system. Very professional operation. Very happy to recommend to anyone looking for a no nonsense system, good price and excellent service. Love your work!!Ian
Blu Sky Solar were very easy to deal with, very friendly, quick to respond to any questions and understood our needs.  I wouldn\'t hesitate to recommend them to any of our friends or family.

One of my panels failed shortly after installation. I phoned the supplier (Blu Sky) and they quickly arranged to have a replacement panel installed and the system reinstated. I had failed to notice that the system was down as the inverter was on the far side of the house where I do not often go . Perhaps thought should be given to providing a monitoring device which could be mounted internally and thus easily visible from a high traffic area inside the house.
Still waiting for our first power bill since the installation. Hoping it reflects well.
We had many qoutes most cheaper and some dearer but Brett the sales person was the reason we chose Blue Sky and up to now we are more than Happy.
Were very helpful in coordinating installation during construction of new home and completing installation in stages.

BlySky installed our system 12/12/12 within 5 days of payment, in the first 6 months our 5kW system has generated over 3,300kW at an average 18kW per day.Thankfully ETSA took 3 months to supply the new meter so when we were generating the most power over summer months, the exported power was turning our meter backwards and we were getting full value for the exported power.  Now we get 75% rebate of the import price for the power we export, but we try to use as much of our daily consumption when the sun is providing our power (washing machine, dishwasher etc) so it is free energy!Our first power bill was $500 less than the previous bill so the system is doing what we needed it to do.Wayne only supplied 2 of the 4 LED light globes promised on the website when we signed up, but they work well...
The performance of the system advised by Blu Sky has exceeded their projections by more than 25%

Blu Sky Solar made the whole daunting process just so easy, from the initial interview (personal visit in home) to the quotation price, handling the various approval and installation processes, to the final installation by fully qualified local installers. Everything was done quickly and efficiently. High quality equipment was provided at a competitive price. Overall an excellent experience.

Have not had system installed as yet but it will go ahead next week. Installers were quick to book job within 1 week of contract signing. Nick from Blue Sky Solar has been a pleasure to deal with - sound advice with no hard sell. Very refreshing.

Nick Annese certainly knew what it was all about and offered a number of options to consider. A very professional operation and I was provided with a comprehensive technical package which is clear and concise to understand.RTC Electrical, who were contracted to carry out the installation, were very courteous and carried out a top quality job.I would recommend anyone to consider Blu-Sky Solar as their preferred supplier/installer.

One of the 3 installers given to me never replied. Blue sky Solar answered promptly and sent a rep. to give me all the details etc.It seemed a good deal so I signed up with him.It was installed a few weeks later and they arranged for the meter to be put in and so far everything seems OK. Will have to wait for Electricity account and hopefully find it is paying off
Blu Sky were very at attentive and the sales consultant was very thorough and informative.Installers very professional.

I complained in writing, with photos, about the poor aspects of the installation. The manager rang me personally to discuss, and offered to arrange for the installers to remedy the items. However, I considered the installation errors so fundamental that I fixed them myself and rejected the offer, given the risk the installers would in fact do more damage. Many customers would not be able to critique installation work, let alone fix it themselves.This continues to be a 'cowboy' industry, where short cuts are common, particularly in supervision by the certification holders.
One of the 3 suppliers chosen by SolarQuotes - Blu Sky Solar - did not contact us.

It was a very quick process and although we were left feeling a little bit overwhelmed by all the information on what we needed to do the main part of the process was relatively painless.The before sales service was great and I thank them for that, but I still feel in the dark what's best for us now and feel that more after sales service is definitely required.
Very impressed - have recommended to family and friends.

The salespeople were very nice and came out to the property quickly. The panels were installed fairly soon after signing up. The electricians explained everything about the inverter and main switches etc. Just waiting on ETSA for the new meter which is the weak link in the chain. They can't install until early December so we can't turn on the panels or ETSA will charge us for the power we create because of the digital meter we have now!!

We had an architect's drawing of panels on our roof and a large north face with a skylight and chimney. We had a lot of trouble getting a consistent story about what could be done from companies quoting. One company would not visit the site. Two companies visited the site but didn't look at the roof.We chose a company that checked out what we asked for with their 'technical person' and said they could do it before the end of June. We signed up. Our information was handed over to an installation company.The installer set a date promptly. An installer came one week before to check out our roof because it was potentially a slightly complicated job. After getting on the roof, installer agreed what we wanted could be done. On the installation date, one week later, a different installer arrived at 7.30am, said it couldn't be done. He advised splitting system between North and West roof. Decided to ring office, do his second job for the day, get office to ring us, and come back in the afternoon. Didn't come back. Office didn't ring back. Eventually at 3pm office said installer who came the previous week made a mistake, didn't know the law, but since he had promised to do it, he would come and do it on another day. I refused to accept an installation the installing company now said wouldn't meet the law. I agreed to have system split between North and West roof. Original installer came next working day and installed on two faces. He was apologetic and professional.For us, this was a horrible experience. From the beginning we got conflicting advice for companies, from salespeople, architects and installers. I wish we had been able to deal with an installer from the beginning. No-one had the whole picture.Did we get the best outcome? I have no idea. Does it work? I presume so. We won't know until ETSA adjust our meter in a few weeks time. This is a dreadful way to do business.

We cannot comment on the performance of the system, as we haven't been connected to the grid, as yet. The sales consultant for Blu Sky was first class with information regarding the system andquestions we asked. The installation occurred promptly and appears to have been done well.We are now awaiting to be connected to the grid by ETSA utilities.

Information provided by Blu Sky Solar was excellent and answered all our questions compared with the other two quotes.  Installation was completed nine days after signing up and deposit paid.  Payment was on completion.  ETSA are to install new meter 9 weeks after installation which is okay given the backlog due to record numbers.

BluSky Solar was thorough, and when a concern was raised after installation, their customer service was second to none. The guys that did the installation also made mention that of the 6 or 7 companies they install for, in their opinion, Blu Sky Solar was the best.

No hard sell by Blu Sky Solar and they did not criticise or comment on other suppliers.  Deposit required was minimal which eased our concerns of supplier failure prior to installation (some suppliers required a substantial deposit or full payment prior to instal which to us was totally unacceptable -too risky).  System was installed within 3 weeks of accepting the quote and was installed in one day with no stress or concerns placed on us and installers tidied up before leaving.  In conclusion, we had many concerns when we commenced our solar 'journey'.  Thanks to Nick from Blu Sky Solar our concerns were unfounded - no hard sell, false statements or slow response to our queries.  We have no regrets and no hesitation in recommending Blu Sky Solar.

Wayne from BluSky Solar assisted us with the purchase of a Solar System.Wayne was very flexible with appointment times for us and answered all of our questions without delay after the initial appointment.We signed up for Solar and within 6 days our system was installed.  A great experience.  We have already recommended Blu Sky to family and friends - with an installation for a family member scheduled for next weekl.

The sales consultant was fantastic. Very friendly, on time for his appointment. Explained solar power and the systems very clearly and was happy to answer all my questions to my satisfaction. After signing the contract, he promptly responded to calls to his mobile with any queries I had. The installers were also very friendly, informative and on time. They carried out their work efficiently and effectively and cleaned up before leaving. I am now hopefully awaiting a pleasant surpprise when my first power bill arrives.Thank you Finn for all your assistance in providing 3 quotes and answering my solar questions.

I lodged an online enquiry on 16/7/2012. Within an hour I had one response and by the next day three! I also had a recommendation for another company from a friend, they wanted to do everything via email, they couldnt be bothered coming out.However Nick came to see us on the morning of the 18/7/2012 and by that evening we had decided to go with Blu Sky. Their presentation was very informed and businesslike so we transferred the $500 deposit.On the 25/7/2012 our 20 x 250 ET panels and SMA Sunnyboy inverter were installed by a very professional team, and once again the paperwork left behind was extremely professional.So a week from woe to go, excellent equipment, incredible service, in fact I cannot think of one thing they could have done better!Now if only they were able to re program my meter!!!!  We will have to wait and see how long the power company takes!
Paul from Blu Sky was excellent. I would recommend them to other people.

I obtained so many quotes and had so much information to wade through it was becoming too large a task for the short time frame available. I spoke with Finn from Solar Quotes who helped me make sense of all the information I had. Without him I would have given up. I then went to Blu Sky solar who were fantastic. They explained the systems and visited the site (none of the other companies wanted a site visit) and whilst they were not the cheapest I have confidence in the company and the product.

The salesperson was okay and the system I bought was a little over priced compare to the other companies who advertised every day in the paper. The only reason I went for this company is they gave me a little discount on the gross amount. It's been nearly 4 weeks and no sign of  the new meter which I can understand due to this company got paper work wrong and it was late sending it in.My biggest issue was the INSTALLERS. They arrived with the wrong panels for a start then on top of that the small brackets were not matching color of the panels  and the workers had the gall to say that they are unable to put all panels in the area which the salesperson had measured up and said they will fit perfectly in the required area. I said NO and stated the required contract with the design of the amount of panels shown.  I must have been the unlucky one to cop these cowboys of who salesperson said do 80 installations a week and do all work for all the solar companies. After the installers left I rang the company salesperson and said my piece of the whole experience which didn't get much reaction from him. I had to ring the roof tiler who only 2 weeks ago did all my ridge capping to call in and check the the amount of broken tiles. He came that evening and found 10 tiles broken the gutters will require painting. My bottom line on the whole experience is if I had to do it again I would have save myself heaps of money and went for the cheapest price I could find because the installers would have been the same ones.
Still awaiting notification from ETSA re: smart meter installation, so I am not receivingany benefit as yet.  I think I will be chasing ETSA pretty soon.

I did not get 3 quotes but only 1 quote instead.  Johnny from Blue Sky Solar was very quick in getting back to me in making an appointment to give me a quote.  He came on the weekend and spent over an hour on the quote and answering our queries.  He was friendly and helpful and explained well.  I was impressed.  I considered his quote reasonable as I also have asked my friends on the prices of their solar installation and so had a rough idea of how much they would cost.   The two guys that came to do the installation of the solar panels and the inverter did a good job.
We were happy with the service from all sales staff.

..i wanted to get solar...but was a bit unsure about the whole solar thing and quite wary as i had seen reports on TV of dodgy intstalations and systems left unfinished for months..!!!..i didnt want that to happen to me..!  i heard about Blusky solar from a friend who had a system installed by them and he was wrapped..so i rang them for a quote..i also got quotes from other firms at the same time. a chap called Wayne came around the next day and gave me ALL the information i asked for and more..any questions i had (even the dumb ones) he answered and walked me through the whole process..!!..the other 2 firms i rang turned out to be call centres that ONLY made appointments for reps to call me back later and they would not answer many questions and were a bit unclear when they did..that didnt make me too confident !..I eventually signed with Blusky and was very happy i did.! The day i signed for a 3kw system, Wayne told me he should have my system up and running in 2 weeks...(it turned out to be less than that,!) within 2 days an installer came over to survey my house and confirm details such as where i wanted my inverter, etc placed..he gave me 2-3 options and said they could come and install in 7 days if that suited me...!!..the installers arrived early in the morning...(3 chaps inc an electrician)...and by lunchtime they were all finished and driving away..!!..they fact that they rang ETSA and organised my new Etsa tarrif meter for me in the deal was great!!..i couldnt be happier..! my last AGL bill before solar was $522....! the bill after i got a $258 CREDIT..!!! my only regret was i didnt go for a bigger system..!!..
The salesperson was prompt, likable and knowledgeable. He followed through without being pushy.

Our family purchased systems from Blu Sky. We were impressed with the salesperson who organized a â€œscopeâ€ prior to any acceptance of the installations. This enabled us to make a more informed decision. The same team of installers did the four houses. A great team of men, very polite, confident, and very competent. Couldnâ€™t be happier. We will just wait now and see if these systems come up to our expectations once AGL has done the meter.

Blu Sky were very efficient.  They were very competetive on price and I was confident that I was getting a quality product.Their installers were on time, friendly and although the weather was not the best plodded on to finish the job that same day.Overall I have nothing but praise for Blu Sky.
No pressure to buy by any of those invited to quote.  Sales reps were informative with Blu Sky best presented.
We would have to spend a lot more money to cover our power bill. RTC installers were very professional & positive.
Happy with purchase & installation and would recommend the company.

Paul was great fom start to finish, wish I could say the same for the installers RTC. RTC attended and scoped the job. A plan was shown to me on how the panels were to be laid. Was also told that they would supply crawl boards to protect the pool solar heating. On the day of installation they arrived without a plan on how the panels were to go on the roof (they asked me how I wanted them). They commenced work without crawl boards. A quick phone call to Paul, this was fixed. Work was stopped until crawl boards arrived. A little while after, a supervisor arrived with crawl boards and showed me a plan on how the panels were to be fitted (this had to be signed off on by me). He apologized as there had been a problem in the office that morning and no paperwork was available for my job. The electrician fitted the inverter only having to move it as the ceiling fan when turned on, hit the inverter (not a big problem but not the only one). The operation of the system was shown to my wife by the electrician. She found him to be rude and not interested. When I arrived home I noticed that the plan I had signed off on was not the same as what was on the roof. The next day I discovered a split in one of the solar tubes which was not there before. I fixed this myself as I didn't want them back.Would not hesitate to recommend Paul or Blu Sky - pass on RTC.

Very good presentation and  a pleasant conversation. Kyle, the manager came to our placeQuotation/CostVery detailed and clear, included an estimated power output of the system.Cost competitiveEquipment QualityI have a Sunnyboy inverter which is number one, there is no better.Panels,  ET panels search on Google and you find a very positive experience from other usersInstallationDone within a day by a very professional team of 4 men, 2 electricians and 2 panel installers. All first class work.System tested at approximately 2pm output 4.9 KW which is good as I am facing NW. It's 5 KW system.ConclusionVery careful, professional people, competitive and top quality equipment.I will recommend them to my friends.

It was a very easy process to organise our solar system. The three companies recommended all responded quickly and then left us to make our decision. The installation was very good. The installers were punctual  and professional. They kept us informed throughout the installation and made sure that we new exactly what was going on. The whole experience was stress free and I would recommend this service to anybody who is considering solar power.

Paul Dunne from the Blu Sky Solar is a fantastic man to deal with. Guys from RTC Electrical Systems are very professional. I will recommend Blu Sky Solar to anybody as it was a very pleasant experience.

I have not rated the installation as it has not happened yet, although it is well over 8 weeks from signing of the contract, mid Sept 2011 we signed.To date any communication from them has only occurred as we have instigated it, I certainly would not recommend them to any of my family or friends.  The mis-communication from them has affected our installation as we were told by the site inspector that our power box would need another mains switch for the solar system.  Advise by site inspector that the switch could be installed on the day of installation, only to get an email some 6 weeks later advising that they could not do it and it would be best to get our own electrician to do this work.  Left hand does not know what the right hand is doing......  Do NOT go with anyone who does not do the installation themselves, as BluSky outsource this work and therefore causing more delays.Saleperson only interested in getting you to sign on the dotted line and really did not know or fully explain the process from sign up to installation of the smart meter.  Nor was he able to give us much in the way specifications of the products they provide, other then the printed brochures which I can source for myself.  Completed our contract without checking the mains switch was required etc, thus this causing a delay in the installation process.Any information I have gained about the solar industry is through doing my own research i.e what if any change to my electricity unit pricing, what products are offerred and the warranty and guarantee.They are not one of the cheapest suppliers of solar products, we solely based our decision on the size of the system and that we would have less panels on the roof, for the same size system offered by cheaper suppliers.

I originally wanted "Q" Panels from Sonnen but they would not come out until after I had given them an order. I don't do that.Matt from Blu Sky came out on time, was polite and knowledgeable and followed up with e-mails and kept us fully informed. Installation was performed by RTC slightly ahead of the estimated date and my meter is spinning happily Backwards. Just waiting for ETSA to change meter so that we can receive payment too. At least we are using less in the meantime. This is all within one month from saying OK.

Have had problems with Blu Sky's banking records saying that I have underpaid by $90.This is not true as I have checked with the bank a number of times via email & phone after Johny has called & emailed each time, & the bank concerned has emailed me my bank statement with amount withdrawn to prove that the amount withdrawn was correct.Someone at Blu Sky's bank must have switched the 4 & 3 around to make the figure $90 less.This has been going on since Friday last week.

Thank you for your recommendations. All 3 prospects were very helpful and contacted me promptly. Two came around to do on-site quotes and based on that I chose Blu Sky as they could supply exactly what I required. Out of a literal swamp of possibilities you assisted me to find what I needed for a reasonable price. Thank you.

Read up - talk to many people and solar panel companies.   I am sure there are a few other companies that would have done a good job but I wanted specific panels and inverter and Blu Sky Solar gave me what I wanted.

System has been installed - just waiting for ETSA to hook up. Salesman was great- came to our house straight away and was ALWAYS available by phone if we had any questions. Installers were great - quick, friendly and answered all our questions. Would recommend this company for sure on service alone.

I found BluSky Solar very comprehensive with the information and choice they gave me. Being new to this type of purchase, I was interested to have a sound understanding of the whole solar purchase. Even though I had done some research of my own, I found Nick from BluSky Solar very informative and he presented me with simple to understand ideas to choose from. The quality of their documentation and follow up information, gave me some comfort that I had chosen the right company to install my solar system. In particular, I found the opportunity to talk to other customers of BluSky Solar very useful as it gave me another chance to get feedback from those people who had already used BluSky Solar as oppposed to looking at comments on a website.
When I emailed you I was suprised at how quick you responded to my request and I was very pleased with the supplier I had chosen to install my solar system.

I don't want to take anything away from Blu Sky Solar or the actual installer (who subcontracted from O'Donnell Griffin) as they were GREAT. But, we had a severe problem with Phil Ward, installation manager with O'Donnell Griffin.  He is the rudest man in the industry.  I have requested an apology from O'Donnell Griffin, but haven't heard anything.    O'Donnell Griffin has a definite problem with the customer service side of their business...we were stood up on two separate scheduled installation times due to Phil Ward's lack of professionalism and/or knowledge of his department's workload and supply.  He was extremely insulting and condescending.
Must say it was an enjoyable experience dealing with  blu sky solar. Have recommended this company and would again. System running well at this stage only time will tell!!!
Paper work got lost, thus delaying the installation. To be installed 2/6/11. Cost of quote increased due to  government cuttingrebates. Quoted $3000 then went to $3300.

Blu Sky Solar was the only supplier to physically visit my home whereas the others only contacted me via email and their quotes were far in excess. I was well informed and showed in detail what was involved, and once I had made up my mind to proceed, the installation was completed within 15 days from signing the acceptance of the quote.  I am now enjoying the sight of my electricity meter running in reverse before a smart meter is available to be installed.

The salesman (Paul Dunn) seemed knowledgeable and gave us what I think is good advise.He is very low pressure and would only quote us after an inspection of our roof to ensure suitability for a solar system, exposure to sunlight, shade etc.Installation is anticipated in the next couple of weeks but so far we are very happy.
